title: 2.8.2.1 crashes when switching the phone from flight mode to normal
symptom: When switching the phone from flight mode to normal mode, AAPS disappears (crashes) without freezing. The issue occurs on a BlackBerry Key2 LE running Android 8, with Bluetooth and NFC on, and using AccuCheck Combo, Libre 2 with patched app, XDrip, and Ruffy.
fix: Restarting Ruffy and then AAPS as a workaround for the crash.
evidence_quote: There are workarounds for the crash: restarting Ruffy and then AAPS (if someone else asks....).
